evaluationChart.title: Pipeline Stage Row & Null Count
evaluationChart.description: Tracks clean record counts across Ingestion, Imputation, Filtering, and GroupBy Aggregation.

advantages: Labeled row/column indexing with heterogeneous dtypes (strings, dates, floats).
Expressive SQL-like groupby, merge, pivot, and rolling window APIs.
limitations: Higher memory overhead than raw NumPy arrays (2x–5x for object columns).
Single-threaded eager execution (consider Polars/DuckDB for >10GB tables).
Chained indexing can trigger SettingWithCopyWarning if not using .loc.

codeTemplates.fromScratch:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame([
    {'id': 1, 'segment': 'Enterprise', 'age': 34, 'spend': 420},
    {'id': 2, 'segment': 'SMB', 'age': 28, 'spend': 140},
    {'id': 3, 'segment': 'Enterprise', 'age': None, 'spend': 510},
])
df['age'] = df['age'].fillna(df['age'].median())
summary = df[df['spend'] >= 100].groupby('segment')['spend'].mean()
print(summary)
